scope: All new payload text and full public-source inventory; existing upstream bytes stay at canonical fixed Git references
public_safety: reviewed: new reports contain measured technical summaries, fixed public identities and synthetic fixtures; no private authorization, Consumption Receipt, real Cloud identifiers, private-original seals, credential values or internal raw logs
source_policy: New code/patch are reviewed. Complete chart/observer trees are existing feature source, including binary vendored Helm chart. All tree blobs must be verified by canonical git-tree-snapshot-v1. Upstream canonical public evidence is byte-preserved; its private-original equivalence and historical publication approval are not claimed.
publication_basis: User bounded permission covers safety-reviewed reports, synthetic fixtures, public input references/copies and delivery records on the dedicated System evidence branch. This record does not create downstream Consumer permission.
handoff_review: The final Handoff is separately schema-validated and scanned before committing; no self-referential digest inventory is constructed.
